name: Boards & Cubes Venteira II 2025
information: Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraII2025#60605-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraII2025#60606-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 10%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraII2025#60609-associados-aps-aps-associates). • If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraII2025#60605-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraII2025#60606-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 10% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraII2025#60609-associados-aps-aps-associates). • ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODY5MjMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--498a82b614a584d91db8f04d80650b14475d7129/Boards&Cubes_NoBAckground_1080%20x%201080%20px%20Logo%202.png) **Espetadores podem assistir gratuitamente! | Spectators may attend for free!** **Apenas será permitido um convidado junto à zona de competição enquanto o respetivo competidor estiver a competir. | Only one guest will be allowed near the competitor area for as long as their corresponding competitor is competing.**
